remarks: 63um mesh part of Schindler-patalas fell apart after completing the first sample at this point (DNA). Modified method was used as follows for the rest of the samples. The hole on the side of the Schindler where the net and dolphin bucket attach was sealed with layered plastic bags. The water was collected in the Schindler as normal but then it was drained through the bottom into the 63um mesh tow net and from there rinsed into the sample bottle.
Modified Schindler patalas method used. See L1 tax sample remarks.
